genome.prompt: Apply the supplied business policy carefully. Return the requested JSON with the correct route and priority.

1. First, identify if the ticket describes an active, ongoing outage affecting ALL users (P0) or active credential theft (P0). If yes, route to security. Else, check if it involves payments/invoices/refunds (billing) with unresolved financial issues (P1) or blocked users/groups (P1). If yes, route to billing. Else, check for legitimate login issues (access) or other. If unresolved, route to access (P1) or other (P2).
Reference training cases (apply policy to the NEW ticket; never copy an unrelated answer):
